battle.name: 那不勒斯戰爭
battle.theater: 那不勒斯王國與義大利北部戰線
battle.brief: 一八一五年三月，那不勒斯國王穆拉特在教宗國境內挑起戰端，在內拉河與明奇奧河連戰失利，兵退回國境。英西聯軍五月自西西里登陸，奧軍南下佔領那不勒斯，加埃塔要塞亦告失守，穆拉特出逃被擒，同年十月在皮佐被處決。火繩槍銃此時早已退作軍械庫舊藏，線上作戰的是滑膛燧發步槍。

kit.name: 火繩槍銃
kit.history: 比步槍輕的長槍。西班牙人帶著它上船，也帶著它進了美洲。

countries: 這是一場發生在聯盟體系內部的戰爭，交戰雙方並非單純的兩國。那不勒斯一方是穆拉特王國：王室出自波旁王朝的西班牙支系，但王位由拿破崙於一八〇八年授予，實際軍權握在法國籍將領手中——北義方面軍由洛朗·德·古維翁·聖西爾統率，托斯卡納方面軍由埃蒂安·麥克唐納率領，基幹是法國舊部與拿破崙體系下的歸順部隊；王國仍控制南部那不勒斯、卡塞塔、加埃塔等要塞與第勒尼海的小型艦隊。反方是第七次反法同盟的地面力量：奧地利帝國以上義大利方面軍為主力，由弗里蒙特伯爵指揮，駐防倫巴第、威尼托與教宗國北部，並由貝勒加德主持倫巴第的軍政及對熱那亞的封鎖；英國以威廉·本丁克爵士的英西軍團在西西里完成集結，含英國步兵旅與漢薩營隊，並以那不勒斯陸軍為輔；托斯卡納大公國與撒丁王國（皮埃蒙特）組成托斯卡納-皮埃蒙特聯軍，由拉吉耶將軍率領；教宗國的貝嫩文托、蓬泰科爾沃等地是首日爭奪點，教宗庇護七世在法軍佔領羅馬期間被扣押於安科納一帶，直至聯軍推進才重獲自由。義大利境內的民眾被徵為築城、築路與後勤勞役，各城的守軍多由法軍與那不勒斯混合編成的分遣隊擔任。
countriesEn: This was a war fought inside a coalition rather than between two states. On the Neapolitan side stood the kingdom of Murat: a crown with Spanish Bourbon blood, but a throne granted by Napoleon in 1808, and real military power in the hands of French officers — the northern Italian army commanded by Laurent de Gouvion Saint-Cyr, the army in Tuscany by Etienne Macdonald, its backbone made up of former French soldiers and Napoleon's own formations. The kingdom still held the southern fortresses of Naples, Capua and Gaeta, together with a small squadron in the Tyrrhenian Sea. Opposed to it stood the ground forces of the Seventh Coalition. Austria fielded the Army of Upper Italy under Count Frimont, stationed in Lombardy, Venetia and the northern Papal States, while Bellegarde administered Lombardy and the blockade of Genoa. Britain assembled the Anglo-Sicilian corps under Sir William Bentinck in Sicily, with British brigades, Hanseatic battalions and Neapolitan troops, and landed on the mainland. Tuscany and the Kingdom of Sardinia (Piedmont) formed the Tuscan-Piedmontese army under General de Laugier. The Papal States — Benevento and Pontecorvo among them — were the prize of the first day's fighting, and Pius VII, held by the French while they occupied Rome, regained his freedom only as the allies advanced. In Italy the population was conscripted for siege works, road building and supply labour, and the garrison of each town was usually a detachment composed of French and Neapolitan troops mixed together.
people: 關鍵人物集中在三方。穆拉特是整件事的樞紐：拿破崙的妹夫，早年以騎兵衝鋒揚名，拿破崙稱帝後娶其妹卡羅琳，一八〇八年廢其王位改任那不勒斯總督，一八一四年退位並被迫交出軍隊，一八一五年一月初帶兵重返王座，隨即在教宗國境內掀起戰端，最終在皮佐被處決。北義戰線由聖西爾全權指揮，他以縱隊緩行、刻意避免會戰，卻在內拉河與明奇奧河兩度被弗里蒙特正面擊破；托斯卡納戰線的麥克唐納老練善戰，是穆拉特陣營中唯一在會戰中得手的高階指揮官。奧地利方面，除統率上義大利方面軍的弗里蒙特外，倫巴第總督貝勒加德以封鎖逼降熱那亞，釋出被法軍扣押的安茹公爵與貝里公爵夫人，後者隨即成為法國南部王黨進軍的領袖。英方由本丁克率領英西軍團自西西里登陸；托斯卡納-皮埃蒙特聯軍由拉吉耶指揮，格勒尼耶師長率那不勒斯主力投入托斯卡納戰線，加埃塔的守軍則由杜尼亞尼少將率領，抵抗到聯軍登陸之後。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities fall into three groups. Murat was the hinge of the whole affair: brother-in-law of Napoleon, famous early for his cavalry charges, married to Napoleon's sister Caroline, stripped of his throne in 1808 and made governor of Naples, and reduced to surrendering his army in 1814 — in January 1815 he returned with his troops and seized the throne, only to be shot at Pizzo the following October. On the northern front Saint-Cyr commanded in full, advancing in columns and refusing battle, only to be broken frontally by Frimont at the Nera and again at the Mincio. In Tuscany the aged Macdonald was the ablest of Murat's commanders, winning the only clear field victory of his side. On the Austrian side, besides Frimont who commanded the Army of Upper Italy, Bellegarde governed Lombardy and brought Genoa to terms by blockade, releasing the Duke of Angoulême and the Duchess of Berry, who had been held by the French; the duke would soon lead the royalist invasion of southern France. The British came under Bentinck, who led the Anglo-Sicilian corps out of Sicily, while the Tuscan-Piedmontese army was commanded by Laugier, Grenier's division forming the bulk of Macdonald's force in Tuscany, and the garrison of Gaeta was held by General Dugnani, who held out until after the Anglo-Sicilian landing had been made.
kits: 火繩槍銃（西班牙語 arcabuz，義大利語 archibugio）是一五五〇年前後西班牙步兵的標準火器：槍身比步槍短而輕，喇叭口便於裝填，燃燒的火繩夾在槍機上點燃火鍋，射擊以三至五發的密集射擊進行，發射後再以通條清膛、重新填藥。它是後來滑膛燧發步槍的直系祖先：火繩機構改為燔鑰、再改為燧發機件，即成十九世紀的線上武器。整條血緣線從西班牙本土延伸到那不勒斯——自十六世紀起王國先後屬西班牙王冠、奧地利王冠與波旁王室，軍械庫的用語與製式一脈相承，一八一五年那不勒斯步兵手中已是口徑約六九線的滑膛燧發步槍（muschetto），而那不勒斯軍械檔案仍以 archibugio 稱呼這類槍身。火繩槍銃的直系親屬中最著名的是西班牙的 trabuco，一支口徑逾二公分的重型火繩槍，重量約十一公斤，用來洞穿騎兵胸甲；它在加勒比與南美殖民地軍隊中一直用到十九世紀中葉，最終被滑膛炮與後膛炮取代。一八一五年戰線上的實際配備是：奧地利方面軍裝備一八〇七年式滑膛燧發步槍與刺刀，配六磅、十二磅野戰炮與爬山炮；英軍為一八〇五式滑膛步槍；那不勒斯軍隊多為法軍 AN IX 式與一八一一年式步槍，均已屬火繩槍銃之後裔。海軍方面，英國地中海艦隊封鎖第勒尼海與亞得里亞海口岸；軍需靠牛車、馬車與沿海補給船輸送。
kitsEn: The arquebus — arcabuz in Spanish, archibugio in Italian — was the standard firearm of Spanish infantry around 1550. It was shorter and lighter than the musket, flared at the muzzle to make loading easy, and fired by a burning cord held in the lock, the shots going in volleys of three to five before the barrel was cleaned out with a ramrod and recharged. It is the direct ancestor of the smoothbore flintlock musket: converting the cord mechanism first to a snaphaon and then to a flintlock produced the weapon of the nineteenth century. That line of descent runs from Spain to Naples, for the kingdom passed in turn under the Spanish crown, the Austrian crown and the Bourbons, and the nomenclature and patterns of its arsenals followed the same track; by 1815 the Neapolitan infantry carried smoothbore flintlock muskets of about .69 calibre, and the Neapolitan ordnance records still called the weapon an archibugio. The best known relative of the arquebus was the Spanish trabuco, a heavy piece of more than two centimetres bore weighing some eleven kilograms, used to penetrate cuirasses; it stayed in service with colonial troops in the Caribbean and South America into the middle of the nineteenth century before giving way to smoothbore and breech-loading cannon. What actually fought in 1815 was the next generation: the Austrian Army of Upper Italy carried the 1807 pattern smoothbore flintlock musket with bayonet, supported by 6- and 12-pounder field guns and howitzers; the British carried the 1805 pattern musket; the Neapolitan troops were largely equipped with the French AN IX and 1811 patterns — all descendants of the arquebus. At sea the British Mediterranean squadron blockaded the Tyrrhenian and the Adriatic ports, while supply moved in ox-carts, wagons and coastal supply ships.
tactics: 三月十三日，那不勒斯軍越過教宗國邊界，先取貝嫩文托，二十日再取蓬泰科爾沃，以騎兵哨騎佔領教宗國南部；但這種縱深推進很快被奧軍主力擋住。內拉河之戰（三月二十二日至二十三日）裡，聖西爾的縱隊在行軍中被弗里蒙特的方面軍正面攔截，奧軍以交替掩護的步兵縱隊配合密集縱深射擊切入，那不勒斯軍放棄渡口退向波河。明奇奧河之戰（四月八日）決定了北線：奧軍強渡後切斷那不勒斯縱隊的聯絡，縱隊首尾不能相望，全軍退回波河南岸的帕爾馬與克雷莫納一帶。熱那亞則以封鎖解決——貝勒加德的攻城炮與封鎖線迫使法軍在四月十九日前後開城，數千守軍連同武裝居民撤往法國。南部戰線由英西聯軍自海路插入：五月二十二日英軍在加埃塔一帶登陸，切斷那不勒斯陸軍的退路，隨後占領那不勒斯城與南部各要塞。托斯卡納戰線上，麥克唐納渡阿爾諾河後在托爾迪基亞納正面會戰，拉吉耶的聯軍依托地形與火炮取得優勢，於八月二日擊潰那不勒斯軍。戰役全程受雨季泥濘與狹窄山道限制，糧秣多由海運或從那不勒斯分批送出。
tacticsEn: On 13 March the Neapolitan army crossed the frontier of the Papal States, took Benevento and on the 20th seized Pontecorvo, patrolling the southern Papal territories with cavalry outposts; but this advance in depth was soon halted by the main Austrian force. At the Nera, on 22 and 23 March, Saint-Cyr's columns were intercepted on the march by Frimont's army, which worked in with alternating columns and massed volleys until it cut into the Neapolitan line, and Murat's men gave up the crossings and fell back toward the Po. The battle of the Mincio on 8 April settled the northern front: after forcing the river the Austrians cut the Neapolitan columns apart, so that the head of the column could no longer see its tail, the army broke, and the survivors withdrew toward Parma and Cremona on the south bank of the Po. Genoa was settled by blockade instead — Bellegarde's siege guns and cordon obliged the French to open the city around 19 April, several thousand defenders and armed citizens withdrawing towards France. In the south the Anglo-Sicilian corps struck by sea: the British landed at Gaeta on 22 May, cutting the retreat of the Neapolitan army, and then occupied Naples and the southern fortresses. In Tuscany Macdonald crossed the Arno and fought a set-piece action at Tor di Chiana, where Laugier's men used the ground and their guns to gain the day and routed the Neapolitan army on 2 August. The whole campaign was constrained by muddy spring roads and narrow mountain tracks, and food was moved either by sea or in small convoys out of Naples.
data: 兵力規模方面，北方戰線的兩軍大致相當：那不勒斯方面在北義與倫巴第可用兵力約三萬至四萬人，奧地利上義大利方面軍約三萬人；托斯卡納戰線上，麥克唐納率約三萬人，拉吉耶的托斯卡納-皮埃蒙特聯軍約一萬二三千人。戰役的時間跨度約三個月：自一八一五年三月十三日開戰，至五月底聯軍進入那不勒斯、六月初南部要塞陸續投降，北線因托斯卡納戰事延續到八月二日。兩場會戰（內拉河與明奇奧河）的傷亡都在數千人量級，沒有任何一方全軍覆沒，但那不勒斯軍在兩戰之後失去主動權。熱那亞守軍與武裝居民撤出約五千至六千人，加埃塔守軍規模在數千人。距離上，波河下游至那不勒斯城約七百公里，行軍需時數週，海軍運輸因此成為聯軍最有效的機動手段。武器參數上，火繩槍銃槍身約四公斤，口徑約十二至十八毫米，遠比同代步槍輕，裝藥量小到打一發後即須重新填裝；十九世紀的滑膛燧發步槍重約四公斤半，口徑約十七點五毫米，並配刺刀。
dataEn: On numbers, the two armies in the north were roughly matched: Murat had perhaps thirty to forty thousand men available in northern Italy and Lombardy against some thirty thousand in the Austrian Army of Upper Italy; in Tuscany Macdonald led about thirty thousand against Laugier's twelve or thirteen thousand. The campaign ran about three months, from 13 March 1815 to the allies' entry into Naples at the end of May and the surrender of the southern fortresses in early June, with the Tuscan front running on to 2 August. Casualties in the two set-piece battles, the Nera and the Mincio, were on the order of several thousand men each; neither army was annihilated, but the Neapolitan side lost the initiative after them. At Genoa some five to six thousand defenders and armed citizens were evacuated, and the garrison of Gaeta numbered a few thousand. In distance, it is roughly seven hundred kilometres from the lower Po to the city of Naples, several weeks' march for an army, which made the Royal Navy's shipping the allies' most effective means of movement. As for weapons, the arquebus weighed about four kilograms with a bore of some twelve to eighteen millimetres, far lighter than the contemporary musket and so lightly charged that a single shot was followed by a full reload; the nineteenth-century smoothbore flintlock musket weighed about four and a half kilograms, with a bore of roughly 17.5 millimetres and a bayonet.
cause: 起因有兩層。表層是王位問題：一八一四年維也納會議把穆拉特貶為那不勒斯總督，並把王位交給波旁親屬；穆拉特保留了西班牙波旁血統的正統宣稱，也保留了自己對軍隊的控制權，等待復辟的時機。一八一五年一月十一日，他與奧地利代表簽訂那不勒斯密約，承諾以兵力和海軍支持波旁王朝在法國恢復，作為交換，奧地利承認其那不勒斯王位。三月一日拿破崙自厄爾巴島返回法國，密約旋即被宣布無效，拿破崙並於三月十三日以法國皇帝的名義廢黜穆拉特；穆拉特隨即在教宗國境內開火，把一場王朝的內鬥變成聯盟與聯盟之間的戰爭。深層原因是義大利的秩序問題：維也納體系要把倫巴第、威尼斯與教宗國交還奧地利與教宗，擴張那不勒斯王國就等於挑戰這套安排；而穆拉特手中這支部隊是拿破崙時代留下的法式裝備與法國人將領拼成的軍團，其忠誠只繫於指揮者本人，意即一旦王朝計劃失敗，這支軍隊隨時會解體。
causeEn: The causes work on two levels. On the surface there was the question of the throne: the Congress of Vienna had reduced Murat to governor of Naples in 1814 and handed the crown to a Bourbon kinsman, but Murat kept his Bourbon claim through his Spanish descent and kept his army, waiting for the moment of restoration. On 11 January 1815 he concluded a secret treaty at Naples with Austrian representatives, undertaking to support with troops and ships the Bourbon restoration in France in return for Austrian recognition of his Neapolitan crown. When Napoleon landed from Elba on 1 March the treaty was declared void, and on 13 March Napoleon deposed Murat in his own name as Emperor of the French; Murat then opened fire inside the Papal States, turning a dynastic quarrel into a war between coalitions. Below the surface lay the question of order in Italy: the Vienna settlement meant to hand Lombardy, Venetia and the Papal States back to Austria and to the Pope, and enlarging the Kingdom of Naples meant challenging that arrangement. The army Murat commanded was itself a legacy of the Napoleonic period, built from French equipment and French officers, and its loyalty attached to its commander alone — the moment the dynastic plan failed, the army was liable to come apart.
impact: 戰後那不勒斯王國於一八一六年與西西里王國合併為兩西西里王國。穆拉特本人在五月出逃時於佩薩羅被奧軍拘留，十月十三日在卡拉布里亞的皮佐被槍決，其子盧恰托被迫入教會，王位由波旁旁支的費迪南德一世接掌。對法國而言，安茹公爵在一八一五年八月率領由西班牙、那不勒斯與皮埃蒙特部隊組成的大軍越過比斯開灣進入法國南部，促成六月路易十八的第一次復位，戰爭餘波延續到秋天。對義大利而言，維也納體系完整恢復：倫巴第與威尼斯重回奧地利統治，教宗國的領土未經正式兼併但重回教宗權下，法國在義大利扶植的姊妹共和國體系壽終正寢；大批流亡的穆拉特軍官進入法國，構成日後義大利復興運動最早的骨幹之一。軍備層面的變化同樣長久：奧地利與英國制式步槍逐步取代那不勒斯軍隊的法式武器，火繩槍銃一類的舊式重火器退為軍械庫陳列與儀仗之用，只有少數博物館仍在收藏。
impactEn: After the war the Kingdom of Naples was united with the Kingdom of Sicily in 1816 as the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies. Murat himself was stopped at Pesaro in mid-May while trying to escape, and was shot at Pizzo in Calabria on 13 October; his son Lucien was forced into holy orders, and the crown passed to Ferdinand I of the Bourbon cadet line. For France, the Duke of Angoulême led an army made up of Spanish, Neapolitan and Piedmontese contingents across the Pyrenees into the south of the country in August 1815, contributing to the first restoration of Louis XVIII in June, and the war's aftershocks lasted into the autumn. For Italy the Vienna settlement was restored intact: Lombardy and Venetia went back to Austrian rule, the Papal territories returned to the Pope without formal annexation, and the system of sister republics that France had patronised in Italy came to an end. Many of Murat's officers went into exile in France, forming one of the earliest seeds of the Italian risorgimento. The change in armament was no less durable: Austrian and British pattern muskets gradually replaced the French weapons of the Neapolitan army, while the old heavy pieces in the arquebus family fell back into the arsenals as exhibits and parade honours, and only a few museums still keep them.
result: 北線以兩場會戰定案：內拉河之戰（三月二十二日至二十三日）與明奇奧河之戰（四月八日）皆由弗里蒙特的奧地利方面軍取勝，那不勒斯軍北線崩潰，退回國境。熱那亞在四月十九日前後開城，安茹公爵與貝里公爵夫人獲釋；五月二十二日英西聯軍在加埃塔登陸，奧軍同時南下，五月下旬進入那不勒斯城，王宮與政府機構易手；加埃塔等南部要塞守軍在五月底至六月初相繼投降。穆拉特於五月初從那不勒斯出走，經卡塞塔、米蘭與印斯布魯克打算走海路回法國，五月十三日在佩薩羅被奧地利部隊截獲，隨後移交那不勒斯新政府處決。托斯卡納戰線上，麥克唐納的軍隊在八月二日托爾迪基亞納會戰中敗於拉吉耶的聯軍，消息傳到前線後士氣崩解，那不勒斯軍隊退回南部，戰爭至此完全結束。那不勒斯戰爭以穆拉特的失敗告終，他的王位、軍隊與性命都沒有保住；同盟軍代價不大，卻沒有解決義大利的問題，反而把奧地利的勢力完整地寫回南歐的地圖。
resultEn: The northern front was settled by two set-piece battles: the Nera on 22 and 23 March and the Mincio on 8 April were both won by Frimont's Austrian army, and Murat's northern line collapsed back across the border. Genoa opened its gates around 19 April and the Duke of Angoulême and the Duchess of Berry were released; the Anglo-Sicilian corps landed at Gaeta on 22 May while the Austrian army moved south, entered Naples in the last days of the month, and the palace and the government changed hands. The garrisons of Gaeta and the remaining southern fortresses surrendered between the end of May and the beginning of June. Murat left Naples in the first days of May, moving through Capua and Milan towards Innsbruck in the hope of shipping home to France; on 13 May he was intercepted at Pesaro by Austrian troops and handed over to the new Neapolitan government, which executed him. In Tuscany Macdonald's army was beaten by Laugier at Tor di Chiana on 2 August, and the news broke the morale of what was left; the Neapolitan troops fell back into the south and the war was completely over. The Neapolitan War ended in Murat's defeat: he kept neither throne, army nor life. The allies paid little for the victory, but the war settled no Italian question; it simply wrote Austrian power back across the map of southern Europe.
